name: io.github.chrischall/freshbooks-mcp
description: FreshBooks invoicing for Claude — invoices, clients, estimates, and payments

environmentVariables.name: FRESHBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional for local sign-in, which saves tokens privately. Required for hosted or legacy environment-token setup.

environmentVariables.name: FRESHBOOKS_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: Registered redirect URI; required on refresh calls too (default https://localhost)

environmentVariables.name: FRESHBOOKS_BUSINESS_ID
environmentVariables.description: The integer businessId to work in when the authenticated identity belongs to several businesses. Without it, reads use the first business FreshBooks lists and writes are refused rather than landing in the wrong books.

environmentVariables.name: FRESHBOOKS_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the account id normally resolved from /auth/api/v1/users/me. Set it explicitly when the authenticated identity belongs to no business membership and resolution fails, or, together with FRESHBOOKS_BUSINESS_ID, when FreshBooks reports no account_id for the chosen business (accounting writes are refused until the pairing is confirmed this way).

environmentVariables.name: FRESHBOOKS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request deadline for API calls, in milliseconds (default 30000)
